task.title: The desktop app opens at a cramped 800x600 default window
task.description: Maintainer observation (2026-08-16): the release .app opens at 800x600 — one row of 3 catalog cards visible; 'not how a user would use the app.' Fix candidates in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json's window config: a larger default (e.g. 1440x900) and/or remember the last window size/position across launches (tauri-plugin-window-state is the standard answer — weigh the dependency against a simple bigger default). Verify the chosen size against the catalog grid's breakpoints (xl:grid-cols-6 wants ~1280+ logical px to feel right) and that first-launch on a small laptop screen clamps sanely.
